text: In the rainy town of Derry, Maine, a small boy chasing a paper sailboat meets a clown waiting in [the storm drain|images|water and drowning]. The next summer his older brother Bill and a band of bullied misfits learn that [children have vanished here for centuries|wants|feeding on the living], taken by a creature that wears [each child's worst fear|rules|it has unnatural powers]. [No adult sees what they see|rules|only some can see it], so the Losers Club follow the sewer maps to an old well beneath a derelict house on Neibolt Street.
